values: Exact real semidefinite extension complexity of the symmetric TSP polytope on N cities: every exact real PSD lift has matrix order at least 2^(cN) for an absolute c>0 and all sufficiently large N; with the subset-flow upper bound, the order is 2^Theta(N).

Exact semidefinite complexity of the symmetric traveling-salesman polytope — Alec Kriebel (ORCID 0009-0001-9320-500X), preprint/publication date 2026-10-06; production Zenodo publication verified 2026-10-07 UTC. Explicit consequence of OpenAI family126 exponential matching theorem and Yannakakis's established 3n-city face projection; checked 2n-city contraction, exact affine slack factors, all-N padding and upper order 2(N-1)+(N-1)(N-2)2^(N-3). No new lower-bound method or firstness claim. Two distinct complete-package AI adversarial reviews passed after a minor README clarification; extensive AI use, no conventional human peer review. Exponential input and TSP theorem are not claimed Lean-verified. Exact real lifts only, no approximate-relaxation or hierarchy-specific claim. Public PDF/source/verification downloads match reviewed hashes; DOI resolves. Record: https://zenodo.org/records/23204250.
